user.title: Import your DekuDeals collection
user.description: Enter your public DekuDeals collection URL. The integration fetches its JSON export automatically; a saved JSON export is optional as an offline fallback.

error.invalid_export: The export must be valid JSON with an items array and a name on every item.

abort.already_configured: This DekuDeals collection is already configured.

init.title: Update your DekuDeals collection
init.description: Replace or clear the optional saved JSON fallback. The integration continues to prefer the live collection endpoint.
